description: List every mailbox connected to the workspace, with its state, its daily cap and its gap between sends. `smtp` and `imap` are null on a mailbox that connects by signing in with Microsoft (Microsoft 365 or Outlook.com) or Google (Google Workspace) instead. `imap` is null on a send-only mailbox (`provider: smtp_only`), which has an SMTP login only.
name: list_mailboxes
title: List mailboxes
